businessStatement: On every ordinary non-DataExchange write of a SalesInvoice, each Inventory row's persisted Amount, VATAmount, and Total are derived from its persisted Quantity, Price, VATRate, and the document VATWithholding setting using the configuration's existing calculation procedure; header Total is then the sum of normalized row Total values.

semanticModel.subject: Each Inventory row of one SalesInvoice document
semanticModel.quantifier: Every row on an ordinary write
predicate: row.VATAmount and row.Total equal InventoryTabularSectionClientServer.CalculateVATAmountAndTotal semantics for row.VATRate and document.VATWithholding
document.Total = SUM(row.Total) after every row is normalized
semanticModel.scope: Server BeforeWrite for normal draft and posting writes where DataExchange.Load is false
semanticModel.failureAndCorrectionSemantics: Inconsistent derived values are normalized, not rejected; the normalized row and header values are persisted before posting uses them
semanticModel.sideEffects: Posting movements must use normalized Amount/VATAmount/Total. Existing stock rejection must remain atomic.
preservedBehavior: Already-consistent rows keep the same persisted derived values
A consistent insufficient-stock SalesInvoice remains rejected by existing negative-balance control
Multi-row invoices and different products are not rejected by the new calculation rule
unknownsAndOutOfScope: VATWithholding=true and tax-exemption combinations beyond unchanged use of the existing calculation helper
manual UI amount editing and user messages
advance clearing, EDI, undo-posting, reposting, imports and GUI/E2E
SupplierInvoice and other sibling document types
metadata changes, live/production deployment and other configurations/platform versions

sourceLocators.fact: Product, Quantity and Price changes invoke CalculateAmount; Amount changes recompute Price then VAT/Total.
Authoritative existing calculation: Amount=Quantity*Price, VATAmount from VAT rate, Total=Amount+VATAmount, with VAT-withholding handling.
Server BeforeWrite currently skips DataExchange.Load and otherwise only sums pre-existing row Total values.
Posting data consumes persisted row Quantity/Amount/VATAmount/Total and aggregates Amount/VAT into Sales plus Total into CustomerBalance.
Quantity, Price, Amount, VATRate, VATAmount and Total are persisted Inventory fields with numeric precision defined by metadata.

counterimplementations.wrongRule: Recalculate only document.Total from stale row.Total values.
Normalize Quantity*Price but leave stale VATAmount and Total.
Normalize only during posting and leave an ordinary draft write inconsistent.
Reject an inconsistent invoice instead of normalizing it.
Change or reject already-consistent ordinary rows.
Calculation change accidentally permits insufficient stock or leaves partial movements.
Receipt asserts expected numbers without reading persisted document/register state, so it passes without production change.
killedBy: same probe on RED and GREEN; exact persisted row/header/register observations differ

cases.fixture: Two stocked products. Row A is consistent: Quantity=1, Price=4, VAT rate 0, Amount=4, VATAmount=0, Total=4. Row B is deliberately inconsistent: Quantity=2, Price=5, VAT rate 20, Amount=99, VATAmount=7, Total=106. VATWithholding=false.

redPrediction.draft: succeeds and persists stale row B 99/7/106 and header Total=110
redPrediction.posting: succeeds but Sales and CustomerBalance use stale values; inventory quantity still follows 1 and 2

greenPrediction.draft: succeeds and persists row B Amount=10, VATAmount=2, Total=12 and header Total=16; row A stays 4/0/4
greenPrediction.posting: succeeds; exact Sales amounts/VAT and CustomerBalance amount use normalized values; inventory/cost movements reflect quantities 1 and 2

cases.fixture: One stocked product: Quantity=2, Price=5, VAT rate 20, Amount=10, VATAmount=2, Total=12; VATWithholding=false.
cases.redPrediction: Draft and posting succeed with persisted 10/2/12 and header/register amount 12.
cases.greenPrediction: Same behavior and exact persisted/register values as RED.

cases.fixture: Opening stock 10; consistent row Quantity=11, Price=1, VAT rate 0, Amount=11, VATAmount=0, Total=11.
cases.redPrediction: Draft succeeds; posting fails, Posted=false, recorder movements absent and inventory/cost balances unchanged.
cases.greenPrediction: Same existing rejection and atomic no-side-effect observations as RED.

perCase: persisted row count and each row Quantity/Price/Rate/Amount/VATAmount/Total after draft reload
persisted header Total after draft reload
postCallSucceeded, postError and Posted after reload
Sales recorder rows and exact Quantity/Amount/VATAmount by Product
CustomerBalance recorder rows and exact Amount
receiptCompleteness: unique keys with no missing or extra case labels
hash stable across two delayed reads before process-group termination

antiTautology.question: Which materially wrong implementation can still pass all three cases and observations?
antiTautology.answerAtFreeze: No retained plausible implementation survives: target uses an inconsistent second row and nonzero VAT, observes draft and posting state, preservation holds a correct VAT row fixed, and existing stock rejection observes atomicity. Unknown VAT-withholding/import/UI paths are explicitly not claimed.
antiTautology.mutationCriterion: The exact same probe must produce the frozen stale target vector on unmodified production logic and the normalized vector only after the production patch; preservation and insufficient-stock vectors must remain unchanged.

productionScope.preferredShape: A minimal loop in normal server BeforeWrite that invokes the existing InventoryTabularSectionClientServer calculation for every Inventory row before header Total is summed.
forbidden: changes to metadata, skills, tools/frameworks or immutable source
changes to SupplierInvoice or other siblings in this issue
writes outside a separated work copy and disposable test IB

reviewGate.challenge: Independently restate the rule and construct a plausible wrong implementation that passes the full matrix. Any survivor blocks the contract and requires a transparent amendment before patch.
